subject: SIG: Live DR playback logistics & RTO/RPO log request
messages:
From: Alex Turner <alex.turner@cloudfin.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@cloudfin.com, Sara Holt <sara.holt@cloudfin.com>
Date: Mon, 08 Nov 2027 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: SIG questions + request for live DR playback and RTO/RPO logs

Hi Tessa,

We're working through the SIG and CAIQ for our June procurement review and have a few follow-ups specific to Business Continuity / DR. Two asks we need to resolve this week:

1) Can Redwood arrange a live "playback" (witness) of a DR recovery run or a dry-run replay for our security team? We want to observe failover behavior, timeline, and operator steps.

2) Please provide sequence logs and RTO/RPO sampling for the last two warm-failover exercises (timestamps and extracted KV-cache warm timings). Specifics we need: start/end timestamps, estimated RPO (seconds/minutes), and any post-recovery latency impacts.

If you can attach a short checklist of what the playback will cover and any pre-reqs for our observers (VPN, MRA access), that would be helpful.

Target audience: CloudFin InfoSec + Procurement. Timeline: preferred windows next Tuesday (11/09) or Thursday (11/11) PST.

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick call to align.

Alex Turner
Sr. Security Analyst, CloudFin Capital
alex.turner@cloudfin.com
[Attachment: initial_sig_request.pdf (application/pdf, 36KB)]

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@cloudfin.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 08 Nov 2027 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SIG questions + request for live DR playback and RTO/RPO logs

Alex — thanks for the clear asks. We can support both items; below is what we propose and a short checklist attached.

Planned scope (high level):
- Live playback: a controlled rehearsal of our warm-standby failover for the inference runtime (non-production model traffic replay). 30–45 minutes, with a 15-minute post-incident telemetry digest.
- Data we will extract: start/end timestamps, RTO measured (seconds), RPO sampling (kv-cache restore intervals), and token-generation latency snapshots pre/post.

Pre-reqs for observers:
- VPN access to our replay view (temporary read-only), 2FA (we'll invite by email), and a single SRV account per observer.
- We will not expose customer PII during the replay; all traces will be sanitized.

Proposed windows (PST):
- Tue 2027-11-09 10:00–11:00 (preferred)
- Thu 2027-11-11 14:00–15:00

Next steps:
1) Confirm preferred window and list of attendees (names + emails).
2) We will share a short playback checklist and the log export link ~1 hour before the rehearsal.

Attaching: redwood_dr_playback_checklist.pdf (contains agenda, observer rules, and telemetry fields we produce).

Ben/Kimberly — can you confirm we can produce the detailed log slice Alex requested and the safe scrub process?

Best,

Tessa Morgan
Head of Security Partnerships (Sales Ops)
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: redwood_dr_playback_checklist.pdf (application/pdf, 48KB)]

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>, Alex Turner <alex.turner@cloudfin.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 08 Nov 2027 13:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SIG questions + request for live DR playback and RTO/RPO logs

Quick operational note from infra: we can produce the playback and the log slices requested. Outline below: 

What we'll deliver during/after playback:
- Live runbook walkthrough from the on-call SRE (10–15 minutes).
- Playback run (warm failover): we will run a simulated traffic replay using recorded non-customer payloads.
- Export package: a zipped archive containing
  - playback-log-20270831.log (trimmed, scrubbed)
  - rpo-snapshots.csv (kv-cache restore timestamps)
  - rto-summary.txt (measured RTOs and short notes)

Scrubbing policy: all traces are automatically redacted for PII and full request payloads. We will provide a short redaction log describing fields removed.

Access mechanics:
- SRE will publish logs to a pre-signed S3 URL ~30 minutes after the run. Link will be time-limited (48h).
- Observers will receive VPN invites and a one-time viewer credential.

I will prepare the export and upload a sample slice now so Alex can review format ahead of time: https://s3.amazonaws.com/redwood-inference/dr-exports/playback-log-20270831.log

Ben Carter
Director, Platform Partnerships
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: playback-log-20270831.log (text/plain, 420KB)]

From: Alex Turner <alex.turner@cloudfin.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@cloudfin.com, Sara Holt <sara.holt@cloudfin.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 09 Nov 2027 08:55:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SIG questions + request for live DR playback and RTO/RPO logs

Thanks — that all looks good. We will take the Tue 11/09 10:00 PST slot and expect 3 observers (myself, Sara Holt from Legal, and one from Infrastructure).

One ask from Legal: can Redwood provide a one-page statement confirming (a) this will be a non-production replay with sanitized traces, (b) logs are time-limited and access-controlled, and (c) no customer content will be exposed? We can sign a short acceptance form before observing. I attached a draft acceptance form for your team to review.

Attaching: cloudfin-dr-acceptance-form.pdf

If you can send the VPN invites and the pre-signed S3 link by 9:30 PST tomorrow, that will give our folks time to connect.

Appreciate the quick turn-around.

Alex Turner
Sr. Security Analyst, CloudFin Capital
[Attachment: cloudfin-dr-acceptance-form.pdf (application/pdf, 12KB)]
